fact: On 28 March 2024 the commune of Golfe 3 officially launched, with UNDP support, the tele-declaration of births and deaths through the Hospi-connect and Hospi-gestion platforms, which connect the municipality's civil status agents to health centres so that they receive birth and death declarations in real time; it is a pilot covering two public facilities, CMS Doumassessé and CHU Campus.
title: Au Togo, une Commune lance la télédéclaration des naissances, avec l’appui du PNUD
